meta.title: Markdown Editor: Gutenberg Docs
meta.description: Load selected Gutenberg documentation pages into the Markdown-backed WordPress editor.
meta.author: Adam Zielinski

steps.code:
<?php
$docs = array(
	array( 101, 'block-editor-handbook', 'Block Editor Handbook', 'block-editor-handbook.md' ),
	array( 102, 'quick-start-guide', 'Quick Start Guide', 'quick-start-guide.md' ),
	array( 103, 'tutorial-build-your-first-block', 'Tutorial: Build Your First Block', 'tutorial.md' ),
	array( 104, 'fundamentals-of-block-development', 'Fundamentals of Block Development', 'fundamentals.md' ),
	array( 201, 'block-api-reference', 'Block API Reference', 'block-api.md' ),
	array( 202, 'block-registration', 'Block Registration', 'block-registration.md' ),
	array( 203, 'block-metadata', 'Block Metadata', 'block-metadata.md' ),
	array( 204, 'block-attributes', 'Block Attributes', 'block-attributes.md' ),
	array( 301, 'package-reference', 'Package Reference', 'packages.md' ),
	array( 401, 'interactivity-api-reference', 'Interactivity API Reference', 'interactivity-api.md' ),
);

foreach ( $docs as $doc ) {
	list( $id, $slug, $title, $source ) = $doc;
	$markdown = file_get_contents( '/tmp/gutenberg-docs/' . $source );
	if ( false === $markdown ) {
		throw new RuntimeException( 'Could not read Gutenberg doc ' . $source );
	}

	$front_matter = sprintf(
		"---\npost_title = \"%s\"\npost_name = \"%s\"\npost_status = \"publish\"\npost_type = \"page\"\npost_date_gmt = \"2026-05-16 00:00:00\"\npost_modified_gmt = \"2026-05-16 00:00:00\"\n---\n",
		addcslashes( $title, "\\\"" ),
		$slug
	);

	file_put_contents( '/markdown-root/' . $id . '-' . $slug . '.md', $front_matter . ltrim( $markdown ) );
}
